dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey perimeters are visible against a dark background; edges are irregular and soft-focused, showing a gradual pixel intensity transition from dark boundaries to lighter internal centers, particularly along the mid-dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated as satellite markers surrounding the larger macro-annuli in the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form a shallow obtuse triangle, with the vertex oriented towards the ventral-lateral plane; a secondary linear alignment of four smaller blobs extends from the mid-body toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-contrast light-colored bifurcated marking resembling a horizontal 'V' is visible on the lower lateral flank near the anterior transition zone.
